segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Good morning, Mr. Tan. I'm Dr. Lim from the anesthesia team. Today we'll be discussing your upcoming knee arthroscopy. Let me start by understanding your medical history. Can you tell me about your knee injury?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Ah, yes. I twisted my knee during a football game last month. The doctor said I have a torn meniscus that needs fixing. Been having pain and swelling since then.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Thank you. Now, let's go through your medications. I see you're on Fluticasone nasal spray, Loratadine, and Montelukast. Have you made any changes to these since your last medical review?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Oh, I stopped the Montelukast already. Think it was mid-2023. Still using the Fluticasone spray every day and taking Loratadine for my allergies.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Thanks for clarifying that. So Montelukast was discontinued in 2023, and you're continuing Fluticasone and Loratadine. Any known drug allergies?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: No, no allergies. I can take all medications without problems.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Great. Have you eaten or drunk anything since midnight? We need to ensure you're NPO for general anesthesia.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Nope, nothing since last night dinner. Just water this morning, but I stopped at 6am as instructed.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Excellent. Any previous anesthesia experiences we should know about?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Once, for a minor hand surgery years ago. I woke up with a dry throat but no other issues. They used general anesthesia then too.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Noted. Finally, how's your overall fitness? Can you walk upstairs or do you get short of breath?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: I can climb stairs slowly, but long walks make my knee hurt. No breathing problems though.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Tan. We'll proceed with general anesthesia using sevoflurane and rocuronium, plus a femoral nerve block for pain control. Your allergies and medications are updated in our system now.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Sounds good, doctor. I'm ready to get this sorted.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: [08:00] induction propofol one hundred twenty milligrams

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: [08:05] tube in, grade one view

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: [08:10] 20G IV in left hand, 500ml LR running

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: [08:30] BP dropped to 80/50, ephedrine 10mg bolus

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: [08:45] HR up to 110, labetalol 5mg IV

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Hi there, how are you feeling after the surgery?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Aiya, my knee still got some pain one, but not too bad lah. The block they give me help a lot.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Good to hear. Any nausea or vomiting feeling after waking up?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Slightly dizzy one, but stomach okay. Not like I want to throw up or anything.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Any trouble breathing or feeling uncomfortable with your airway?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Throat a bit sore from the tube, but breathing is fine. Can talk normally also.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Do you remember anything about the surgery itself?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Nope, all black out. Wake up already in recovery room.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: You mentioned allergic rhinitis before. Any nasal congestion or allergy symptoms now?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Nose a bit blocked, but not sneezing or watery eyes. Same as usual lah.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: We'll keep an eye on that. Overall, how are you coping?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Quite okay, doctor. Just want to go home and rest. Thank you for checking on me.
